notes: B=1 measurements supplement the September results on October 10; the historical source and dependencies are unchanged.
Amortized per-observation cost is not individual request latency.
RxR B=4 failed after 384/3879 observations; partial throughput is not reported as a complete result.
Different tensor batch shapes may change generated histories; no exact output or navigation-quality equivalence is asserted.
